bundle.shortDescription: Preview a SQLite migration before it touches your database.
bundle.longDescription: MigraDry applies a SQLite migration to a disposable clone, compares the schema before and after, and verifies by SHA-256 that the content of the original database was left byte-identical. Migration SQL never runs against the database you select.
